address: 6-7F, 9 Dinh Tien Hoang Street, Hoan Kiem Ward, Hanoi, 11006, Vietnam
bio: Enter the building from Dinh Tien Hoang or Cau Go Street and ride the lift to the restaurant. You can expect authentic, immaculately seasoned Central Vietnamese cuisine. Don't miss the deep-fried traditional Vietnamese spring rolls. If you go as a group, definitely order their popular hot pot – either chicken with basil leaves or beef and a wide range of other ingredients. The window seats and 7th-floor terrace command scenic lake views....
